title: Data Engineer
description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote

Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@tebra.com (http://tebra.com/), @patientpop.com (http://patientpop.com/), or @kareo.com (http://kareo.com/)) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer focused on AI/ML, you’ll build, maintain, and optimize the data infrastructure that powers Tebra’s intelligent features. You’ll partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to transform complex healthcare data into high-quality datasets and real-time features that enable machine learning models.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll contribute to scalable data pipelines, improve data quality, and help ensure our AI systems are powered by reliable, performant, and well-governed data. You’ll work on modern data platforms and gain experience building solutions that support both model training and production inference.

Your Area of Focus

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for feature extraction, training data generation, and model monitoring.

• Develop and enhance data systems that support analytics and machine learning workloads, including data lakehouse and feature store technologies.

• Monitor production data pipelines, identify data quality issues or pipeline failures, and implement improvements to ensure reliability and freshness.

• Participate in engineering design discussions and contribute to technical decisions around data architecture and pipeline implementation.

• Build reusable data engineering components, including automated data quality checks, schema validation, and testing frameworks.

• Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions that enable analytics and machine learning use cases.

• Optimize SQL queries, Spark workloads, and data processing pipelines to improve performance and scalability.

• Collaborate with ML Engineers and cross-functional partners to support MLOps best practices, including data versioning, lineage, and reproducibility.

• Break down technical work into manageable tasks and deliver high-quality solutions within an agile team.

Your Professional Qualifications

• 3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining production data pipelines supporting analytics, reporting, or machine learning workloads.

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL with experience developing production-quality data pipelines.

• Experience with modern data processing technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or similar distributed data platforms.

• Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Delta Lake, or equivalent lakehouse technologies.

• Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance best practices.

• Familiarity with machine learning data workflows, including training datasets, feature engineering, and data quality concepts.

• Experience deploying and supporting production data pipelines with monitoring, testing, and CI/CD practices.

• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

• Excellent communication skills and a desire to continuously learn new technologies and engineering practices.

#LI-SS1 #LI-Remote

We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with competitive and fair compensation. For this position, this range reflects our Zone 1 (National Average) pay band. Your specific compensation is thoughtfully determined by your experience, qualifications, the specific requirements of the role, and your Geo Zone. Our geo-zone system ensures your pay is competitive for your location, recognizing varying costs of labor across regions.

Our four geo zones are designed to reflect this:
Zone 1: National Average
Zone 2: Moderately Higher Cost Regions
Zone 3: High-Cost Regions
Zone 4: Lower-Cost Regions

Beyond base compensation, Tebra offers eligible employees the opportunity for variable pay and a robust benefits package, reflecting our commitment to your overall well-being. In compliance with California pay transparency laws, the specific compensation range applicable to your Geo Zone will be shared during your initial talent screen.

Zone 1 (National Average)

$128,000—$145,200 USD

Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at www.tebra.com (http://www.tebra.com/).

Our Values

Start with the Customer

We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.

Keep It Simple

Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.

Stay Entrepreneurial

We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.

Better Together

We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.

Celebrate Success

Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.

Perks & Benefits

United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.

California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/

If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at talentacquisition@tebra.com and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.

This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. title: Staff Software Engineer (SRE)
description:
Phantom (https://phantom.com) is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom (https://jobicy.com/company/phantom) to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Responsibilities

•
Kubernetes Ownership: Manage and scale Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS, ensuring reliability, performance, and security.

•
Infrastructure Automation: Implement and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.

•
Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize system performance, scalability, and resource utilization.

•
Blockchain Infrastructure: Configure and maintain crypto nodes across multiple blockchains to support our wallet’s operations.

•
Database Scaling: Optimize and scale database infrastructure to handle terabytes of blockchain data efficiently.

•
System Reliability: Continuously improve system uptime, monitoring, and observability using tools like Datadog and OpenTelemetry.

•
Collaboration: Work closely with backend and product teams to support feature development and system scaling.

Qualifications

•
8+ years in a SRE or Software Engineer role.

•
Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production environments.

•
Proficiency with AWS infrastructure and services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM).

•
Solid experience with Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

•
Monitoring and observability experience using tools like Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

Why Work with Us

We are a team of experienced builders in the blockchain and crypto industry. Our journey began from users seeking an easy, seamless path to accessing the crypto ecosystem. This passion fueled our exponential growth, allowing us to onboard over 20M+ active users in just over three years; with our user base growing weekly. Our dedication to a secure and seamless user experience has made us the leading wallet on Solana as well as our multi-chain approach enhances our platform's versatility, meeting the needs of a diverse and growing user base. By staying at the forefront of technology and user expectations, we continue to innovate and set industry standards on self-custodial crypto wallets.

There has never been a better time to work in crypto to help shape the future of innovation with a focus around the wallet experience!

•
First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

•
Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

•
We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

•
Competitive salary and equity

•
You will be eligible to participate in the Company's performance bonus program

•
Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered

•
Stipend for your ideal remote set-up

•
Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment

•
Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

•
401(k) retirement plan

•
Monthly wellness benefit

•
Weekly meal benefit

•
Global off-sites

The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer at Prove, you will play a critical role in building, maintaining, and scaling the technology that powers the next generation of identity verification. Whether working on consumer and business identity services or developing low-level phone intelligence data signals, you will design and implement robust, high-performance solutions. Team Focus Areas

We are currently hiring for two engineering teams, each solving unique challenges in the identity space:

• Data Engineering Team: Join our team to design and build the fault-tolerant, scalable platforms powering our core identity services (Verified Users, Prefill, and KYB/KYC). You’ll work hands-on with senior engineers and product leaders to tackle complex, high-scale architectural challenges and directly influence our identity verification roadmap.

• Phone Number Intelligence: Our team focuses on phone intelligence and generating low-level data signals used by various internal services. This work is foundational to our fraud detection capabilities, providing specialized knowledge of mobile carrier data and fraud patterns. We are currently migrating data and migrating to an event-driven architecture, offering an exciting opportunity for someone to shape our infrastructure.

Responsibilities

• Engineering Excellence: Write high-quality, maintainable code, develop detailed technical documentation, and champion strong engineering principles within the team.

• System Development: Design and develop microservices within a cloud-native, distributed architecture.

• Problem Solving: Analyze, debug, and resolve production issues. Proactively engage in technical design discussions, including writing and reviewing RFCs for new solutions.

• Technical Leadership: Mentor team members, participate in code reviews, and drive technical decisions. Own end-to-end features—from initial design and RFC creation to implementation and maintenance.

• Collaborative development: Participate in the "Owner/Helper" project model; contribute as a lead owner for major milestones and actively support team members on their own initiatives.

Your First Three Months

30 Days (Onboarding): Gain a high-level understanding of our architecture, team goals, and existing services. Make your first code contributions by resolving bugs or tackling small tasks within the codebase.

60 Days (Contribution): Integrate into the design process by reviewing RFCs and providing technical feedback. Contribute significantly as an active team member to one of our milestones.

90 Days (Ownership): Develop a deep grasp of our product and migration strategies. Take ownership of a minor or major milestone, or lead the drafting of an RFC for a new initiative.

Qualifications

• Software Development: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a deep understanding of object-oriented programming (Java highly preferred).

• System Design: Experience designing event-driven, robust, and scalable solutions for complex technical problems.

• Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Data & Database Expertise: Proficiency in SQL (Oracle) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) with strong knowledge of design principles for both.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Full-Stack Development: Experience with TypeScript and React.

• CI/CD & Testing: Ability to build automated test frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.

• Streaming Technologies: Practical experience with Kafka and Flink.

• Modern Tech: Familiarity with AI and machine learning integrations.

• Technical Leadership: Proven ability to influence team direction and long-term architectural decisions.

title: Market Research Data Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Denmark

URL: https://baymard.com/

We’re seeking a full-time, remote Market Research Data Analyst for our company.

Baymard Institute conducts large-scale UX research studies, sharing our findings through a bespoke B2B SaaS platform (https://baymard.com/research) that serves 2,000+ retailer stores, brands, and agencies across 80+ countries — including 71% of Fortune 500 e-commerce companies. We’re fully distributed, with ~60 team members spanning America and Europe, all committed to advancing ecommerce UX.

What You’ll Do

As our Market Research Data Analyst, you’ll own quantitative survey studies from initial research and questionnaire design through fieldwork, analysis, and publication.

Our Quant Insights team conducts recurring studies (https://baymard.com/blog/quantitative-insights-launch) examining how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products and services online across different industries and focused topics. A typical study takes approximately three months from beginning to end. Once one study is completed, you’ll begin the research cycle again in another industry or topic area.

This means the role combines variety in subject matter with consistency in research methodology. You might spend one study investigating how consumers shop for electronics and the next examining how they book flights, while following a similar end-to-end research process each time. However, a significant part of this role involves repeatedly executing and improving a structured research process.

At the same time, the process itself is not fixed.

Our Quant Insights team is relatively new, and our research program continues to evolve. Team members are encouraged to challenge existing approaches, experiment with better methods, improve our tooling and workflows, and propose changes to how studies are designed or executed.

If you identify a better way to design a questionnaire, analyze our data, automate part of the workflow, structure a study, or even rethink part of our research process, we want you to make the case for it and help us improve it.

Your responsibilities will include:

Research & Survey Design

•
Conducting desk research to understand an industry, its consumers, and the ecommerce experiences we want to investigate.

•
Translating research objectives into clear, testable research questions.

•
Designing questionnaires, including question wording, response scales, survey structure, branching, and screening criteria.

•
Identifying appropriate respondent audiences, quotas, and sample requirements.

•
Reviewing pilot results and refining questionnaires before full fielding.

•
Considering potential sources of survey bias, measurement error, and data-quality issues throughout the research process.

Survey & Fieldwork Execution

•
Programming and QA’ing surveys (we use Alchemer), including logic, quotas, branching, and redirects.

•
Coordinating with sample providers on feasibility, targeting, and setup (we use PureSpectrum).

•
Monitoring soft launches and active fieldwork.

•
Evaluating incoming responses for data-quality issues and determining appropriate cleaning or exclusion criteria.

•
Troubleshooting issues independently.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

•
Cleaning, structuring, and analyzing survey datasets.

•
Conducting descriptive and comparative analyses across questions and respondent segments.

•
Exploring relationships and meaningful differences within the data while avoiding overinterpretation of results.

•
Identifying the most meaningful findings from large survey datasets rather than simply reporting every result.

•
Synthesizing findings across multiple questions to develop broader insights into consumer behavior.

•
Creating charts and writing analysis takeaways that communicate findings clearly.

•
Translating quantitative findings into concise, evidence-based insights relevant to ecommerce UX professionals and decision-makers.

Your role may gradually expand to include new or more complex studies, program management, or strategic initiatives, depending on your interests and Baymard’s needs.

Your Daily Tasks

While your exact workload will vary depending on where your current study is in its lifecycle, most of your time will involve activities such as:

•
Researching consumer behavior within an industry.

•
Designing and refining survey questions.

•
Programming and QA’ing surveys.

•
Reviewing pilot data and determining what should change before launch.

•
Coordinating sampling and monitoring fieldwork.

•
Cleaning and preparing survey datasets.

•
Analyzing overall results and meaningful respondent segments.

•
Investigating interesting or unexpected patterns in the data.

•
Determining which findings are meaningful enough to publish.

•
Creating charts and synthesizing findings into clearly written research insights.

The remainder of your time may involve team discussions, methodology development, documentation, process improvements, tooling, cross-functional collaboration, or experimentation with new approaches.

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who:

•
Enjoys both the design and analytical sides of quantitative research.

•
Likes taking ownership of a research project from an initial question through final findings.

•
Enjoys working with structured processes and becoming better and more efficient at executing them over time, while offering ideas and initiative to improve and streamline them as needed.

•
Is naturally detail-oriented and methodical in their work.

•
Is comfortable troubleshooting and resolving field issues independently, but knows when to escalate larger problems for discussion or review

•
Communicates clearly and asks precise questions when clarifying requirements.

•
Enjoys cross-functional work and being involved in the early stages of a program.

What You’ll Need

We’re looking for the following qualifications for this role:

•
2–3+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, market research, survey research, consumer insights, or a closely related field.

•
Hands-on experience designing questionnaires and conducting online survey research.

•
Experience analyzing survey datasets and synthesizing quantitative findings into meaningful conclusions.

•
A solid understanding of survey design fundamentals, including question wording, response scales, questionnaire structure, screening, and common sources of bias.

•
Experience working with survey platforms such as Alchemer, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or similar.

•
Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, statistical software, or other analytical tools to explore and analyze quantitative data.

•
Comfort interpreting percentages, distributions, cross-tabulations, and differences between respondent groups.

•
Ability to communicate findings clearly, in writing, to audiences who may not have a research background.

•
Strong communication skills and a disciplined, detail-oriented working style.

You’ll be part of our growing Quant Insights team and will work closely with the Research, Product, Engineering, and Commercial Operations teams, making collaboration essential.

Practical Details

•
Location: This is a remote, full-time position from the UK, Ireland, or the EU. Baymard is a registered employer in the UK, IE, and DK.

•
Language: We expect you to be fully proficient in written English. Written English is critical to this role, and you will have to submit your application/cover letter in English.

•
Salary: Based on qualifications and country average.

•
Start date: As soon as possible.

•
Travel: Is limited; expect only 1-2 weeks of travel each year (often only in connection with the company-wide meetup).

•
Company: Learn more about Baymard’s work culture and values here (https://baymard.com/jobs). Also, consider reading this article (https://baymard.com/blog/quantitative-insights-launch) about our Quantitative Insights work.

How to Apply

If you’re interested in this position, please apply by sending all of the following documents:

•
A cover letter written in English (PDF format; 1-2 pages) describing how you fit the role and qualifications. (Required.)

•
A CV/resume (PDF format) or a link to your LinkedIn profile. (Required.)

Send the above to quant2026@baymard.com.
(All applications and materials are treated confidentially.)

Deadline is November 15th, 2026 (end of day).

Sincerely,
Richard Lam, Quant Insights Lead at Baymard Institute

Referral Bonus: If this job isn’t you, but you know someone who’ll be the perfect fit, please send them the link to this page. If we end up hiring the person you referred, we’ll give you 12 months of access to a Baymard Expansion (https://baymard.com/research) plan (normally $4,200/year).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/baymard-institute-market-research-data-analyst

description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Oportun’s flagship, AI-powered Savings product. Savings is an important driver of member growth and retention, giving this role significant influence over the future of our financial health platform and how we help members build stronger financial futures.

You’ll lead the ideation, development, launch, and scaling of new products and features while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support. This role reports to the Vice President & General Manager for Savings and Mobile. Candidates located in Central or Eastern time zones are strongly preferred to support team and stakeholder collaboration.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll lead the long-term product strategy and roadmap for Oportun’s Savings product in partnership with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

• You’ll scope and lead the development of new products and features designed to improve members’ financial health and strengthen growth and retention.

• You’ll use customer research, experimentation, data, and product metrics to build a deep understanding of member needs and behaviors and translate those insights into product decisions.

• You’ll lead a high-performing cross-functional product team across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support to bring new capabilities to market.

• You’ll drive alignment across teams and leadership through clear communication, thoughtful documentation, and strong product judgment.

• You’ll navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations while keeping the team focused on member outcomes and execution.

• You’ll bring ideas for how we can do things better, proactively, not just when asked.

• You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate product discovery, improve decision-making, reduce manual work, and create stronger member experiences.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a curious and creative product leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning customer needs into clear product strategies. You combine strong product judgment with data, move comfortably between strategy and execution, and build trust across a wide range of partners.

You’re customer-focused, solution-oriented, and comfortable navigating complexity without waiting for perfect information. You communicate clearly, build alignment, and keep teams moving toward meaningful outcomes.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• 7+ years of product management experience, including experience building and scaling products in high-growth environments.

• A strong track record of defining product strategy, building roadmaps, and shipping products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

• Strong customer orientation and a passion for building products that improve financial health.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with experimentation, product metrics, data analysis, and data-informed decision-making.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product teams and building alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, Customer Support, and senior leadership.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex product decisions clearly and concisely.

• Experience navigating ambiguity, removing blockers, and driving execution across complex product initiatives.

Nice to Have

• Experience in financial services, fintech, digital banking, or another highly regulated industry.

• Experience launching products within complex legal or regulatory frameworks.

• Experience using SQL or similar tools to support product analysis and decision-making.

• Experience working with globally distributed or multinational teams.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools to improve product discovery, analysis, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

US Benefits:

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

• 401(k) including company match

• Flexible PTO and Parental Leave

• Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

description:
Headquarters: Remote US

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: SDR Manager

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $58,500 base with on target earnings at $78,000 plus equity

What You'll Do:

Huntress is looking for a talented and passionate Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help fuel our continued growth. In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. You are outcome-obsessed in how you work, with a clear eye on the right next step, the right partner fit, and the follow-through it takes to create real pipeline impact.

In the daily rhythm of prospecting into the MSP and MSSP space, you bring warrior spirit. You stay steady through rejection, keep your standards high, and come back sharper on the next call. You also give a sh*t about the people on the other end of the phone, leading with honesty, curiosity, and respect as you help prospective partners understand the value Huntress can deliver to their business and their customers.

Responsibilities:

• Establish rapport and trust with managed service provider (MSP) and managed security service provider (MSSP) prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to understand their business and their fit with Huntress.

• Set qualified meetings within our ideal customer profile by following best practices and standard processes.

• Generate and qualify net-new accounts and work inbound opportunities to create a pipeline for the Account Executive team.

• Use clear, value-driven messaging to build interest in Huntress and answer prospect questions with honesty, professionalism, and empathy.

• Research accounts, document prospecting activity, and qualification notes in CRM, and maintain strong data hygiene.

• Use AI tools with good judgment to support account research, call prep, and message drafting in your day-to-day work.

• Keep improving your cold calling, messaging, and pipeline management skills through training, feedback, and repetition.

What You Bring to the Team:

• 8+ months of experience in a quota-carrying outbound B2B SaaS sales role.

• Experience with outbound cold calling.

• Strong time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.

• Comfort working across CRM, prospecting tools, and multiple systems at the same time.

• Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.

• A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.

• Curiosity about AI and the judgment to use it in practical ways that help you work faster and smarter in your day-to-day.

What We Offer:

• 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015

• Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans

• 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution

• Life and Disability insurance plans

• Stock options for all full-time employees

• One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office

• Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance

• $75 USD/month digital reimbursement

• Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Reports to: SDR Manager

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $58,500 base with on target earnings at $78,000 plus equity

• Use clear, value-driven messaging to build interest in Huntress and answer prospect questions with honesty, professionalism, and empathy.

• Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.

• A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.

title: Business Risk Officer
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify our customer’s financial lives whether they are entrepreneurs, business owners, or individuals.  Mercury has also obtained a provisional national bank charter and is currently taking proactive steps for final approval.

Role Overview:

We're looking for a Business Risk Officer to help scale the way Mercury builds products.  In this role you will report to our Head of Business Risk & Enablement and will partner with Product, Operations, Compliance and many other support and oversight teams to ensure that products and features are delivered “best-in-class” in a safe and sound manner.  Your success in this role will rely on subject matter expertise in one or more of Mercury’s core product offerings and associated risks. You will also be primarily responsible for the facilitation of non-financial risk management programs (see below).

Key Responsibilities:

• Identify any potential blind spots in processes and controls, and suggest commercial improvements/enhancements

• Facilitate pre-launch and new activity initiatives/reviews, tracking items to closure and escalating where/when necessary

• Facilitate execution of risk self assessments and similar exercises within the non-financial risk frameworks

• Event/incident, issues , and remediations management - ensuring that incidents and issues are recorded and managed through to remediation in line with any and all relevant frameworks in the company

• Develop and enhance iteratively KPIs/KRIs to be monitored by yourself, product/process owners, and other stakeholders in order to mitigate risk

• Coordinate interactions and responses between Product and Operations teams vs. other stakeholders for audits, exams and similar reviews (internal and external)

• Engage and partner deeply with stakeholders across the organization including Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, etc.

• Help design / provide feedback on certain enterprise/firm-wide trainings and deliver trainings as needed

Qualifications:

• Have at least 5 - 7+ years of experience in a banking, fintech, or other financial services firms in a product/business, business risks and/or controls, operational risk, or other similar roles

• Track record of balancing risk, compliance, and customer experience in cross-functional settings

• Excellent communication skills to simplify complex business, reg and/or risk concepts into clear explanations and/or recommendations

• Familiarity with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) practices and non-financial risk frameworks

• Curious, growth-oriented, and motivated to work on risk and controls at all lifecycle stages (new product launches, scaling, and legacy optimization)

• Bring a collaborative, problem-solving mindset to your work, have strong stakeholder management skills, and an ability to influence without direct authority

• Approach your work with a high quality bar and a strong sense of ownership - you see things through to completion, knowing when to be pragmatic vs. when not to settle

• Proficient with AI tools, or eager to get there, to drive efficiency in risk and controls work — a growth mindset is enough if you're not an expert day one.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Exposure to product or technology development lifecycles (e.g., involvement in pre-launch reviews, feature rollouts, or cross-functional builds) — doesn't need to be a formal PM background, just familiarity with how products move from idea to launch

At Mercury, building our customer base has been a wild and exciting adventure—and we’re just getting started. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a thoughtful, driven Account Executive to help more founders, finance leaders, and business owners discover and thrive with Mercury.

Over the past two years, we've significantly expanded our startup customer base and we’re continuing on that journey to support even more startups and teams on Mercury. In this role you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with founders and finance leaders helping them shape the future of their finance stack with Mercury at the center. You’ll uncover pain points tied to current operations, run point on complex evaluations with multiple-products, and simplify the migration process across their full-stack into Mercury.

• Sell across multiple products in longer, more strategic cycles

• Multi-thread across stakeholders and build champions inside the account

• Build mutual action plans and drive deals forward on a shared timeline

• Influence requirements in Mercury's favor as accounts evaluate their options

• Orchestrate multiple stakeholders and moving pieces at once without dropping the thread

• Own and expand the relationship across the first 90 days of the customer journey

• 1+ year of closing experience, primarily cold outbound-driven, in SaaS, fintech, or similar

• Track record of converting cold leads into long-term partners, not just first meetings

• Comfortable running multi-product, strategic selling cycles rather than single-product transactional ones

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About the Job

The Opportunity

As a Growth Marketing Manager at JivPad, you will architect and execute the strategies that drive user acquisition, activation, and retention for a platform redefining human communication. JivPad is a modern communication system powered by AI, enabling individuals with speech or hearing differences, and anyone who desires intelligent call assistance, to connect with confidence and authenticity. Our platform also delivers real-time translation for in-person conversations, removing language barriers entirely.

In this role, you will own the full growth funnel, from awareness through conversion and beyond. You will identify high-leverage channels, design experiments, and scale what works, all while maintaining the premium positioning that defines our brand. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams to turn insights into action and data into momentum.

This is a rare opportunity to build the growth engine of a company from the ground up, where your decisions will directly determine how quickly the world adopts a new standard in communication.

What You'll Do

Develop and execute data-driven growth strategies across paid, organic, referral, and partnership channels to drive user acquisition and revenue. Own the full marketing funnel, optimising every stage from awareness and consideration through to activation, retention, and expansion. Design, launch, and iterate on experiments across channels, messaging, audiences, and creative to identify scalable growth levers. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to implement growth loops, referral mechanics, and in-product conversion optimisations. Build and manage performance marketing campaigns across platforms while maintaining cost efficiency and brand integrity. Analyse user behaviour, cohort data, and market signals to uncover insights that inform strategy and prioritisation. Partner with Content, Brand, and Community teams to ensure growth initiatives align with JivPad's premium positioning and mission.

What You'll Need to Succeed

A degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related discipline, with 2+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or demand generation within a technology or SaaS organisation. Demonstrated success in building and scaling acquisition channels, with a strong command of paid media, SEO, email, and lifecycle marketing. Experience thriving in fast-paced, early-stage environments where resourcefulness, ownership, and speed of execution are essential. A deeply analytical mindset, comfortable working with data, attribution models, and experimentation frameworks to drive decisions. A deeply collaborative disposition, with the ability to work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Design, and Marketing to deliver unified growth initiatives. Genuine passion for accessibility, inclusive technology, or communication innovation is highly valued.

Role Details

Employment Type: Full-Time and Part-Time positions available Location: Fully Remote Stage: Founding team, pre-launch

About JivPad

JivPad is a modern communication platform built on the belief that everyone deserves to be heard, understood, and in control of their own voice. Our AI-powered calling technology enables users to make phone calls with full autonomy, whether they choose to speak through AI using their own cloned voice, direct the conversation in real time via text, or seamlessly take over the call themselves. Our live translation feature allows people speaking different languages to converse naturally, in person, without delays or interruptions.

We are not building another AI calling tool. We are building the future of human connection, where technology amplifies who you are rather than replacing you.

Equal Opportunity

JivPad is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome dedicated individuals regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We believe that extraordinary products are built by extraordinary teams, and extraordinary teams are built on inclusion, respect, and the understanding that brilliance has no single origin.

If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to our team and we will ensure your needs are met with care.

Let's build the future of communication, together.

description:
AI at Zapier (https://jobicy.com/company/zapier)

At Zapier (https://zapier.com/about), we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process (https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier), including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

AI Fluency Assessment (https://ai-fluency-hub.vercel.app)
Take our 10 minute AI Fluency Assessment by clicking the link above. See how your skills stack up against our sales bar, get a personalized tier, and walk away with actionable next steps to level up your AI skills.

Job Posted: June 2026

Location: India

Hi there!

We’re looking for a new Sales-Assist Representative to join the Sales-Assist Motion at Zapier.

Zapier’s on a mission to make everyone more productive at work. We are in search of individuals who are not just looking for a job, but are committed to building a rewarding career in sales. Ideal candidates will possess a genuine passion for sales, a desire to continually learn and improve, and the drive to achieve excellence within the industry.

Zapier has helped millions of people build businesses through the power of automation. The Sales Assist group serves customers as they evaluate and buy Zapier’s offers, through a high-velocity sales motion. We help customers primarily through live chat conversations through Zendesk, and some inbound demos over Zoom. We inspire deep automation use-cases pertaining to their role, and address any questions through their procurement and buying process. Ultimately, success here looks like removing friction from the purchase and adoption process through qualifying or converting leads.

If you want to advance your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, read on…

•
Our Commitment to Applicants (https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/)

•
Culture and Values at Zapier (https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/)

•
Zapier Guide to Remote Work (https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/)

•
Zapier Code of Conduct (https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/)

•
Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier (https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/)

About You

•
You are located in India and able to work within the hours of ~9:00 pm - 7:00 am IST.

•
4+ years of experience, with a track record as a solutions engineer, technical account manager moving to sales, or a very technical quota-carrying salesperson with experience in a SaaS environment, especially across technical product-led companies with both self-serve and sales GTM) with exposure to international markets.

•
Able to work a high velocity sales queue for prolonged periods of time in your day (Live Chat)

•
You're naturally curious about AI and regularly experiment with different AI tools to drive efficiency in your day-to-day work or personal life.

•
You’re experimental and have the ability to test our ideas rapidly and contribute to multiple sales projects.

•
You’re comfortable getting into the technicalities of our product, API offerings and curious about building solutions with these tools.

•
Self-managing and a high degree of agency to manage your calendar, pipeline and hit quotas

•
Effective cross-cultural communicator — able to communicate clearly with both customers and a distributed international team. Advanced working English comprehension.

•
You use AI in your work today — not occasionally, but as part of how you operate at a high level. You can point to workflows you’ve built, how your approach has evolved through iteration, and the impact on quality, efficiency, and experience — while intentionally applying AI for the right outcomes, setting a high bar for outputs, and taking ownership of what ships.

Things You’ll Do

As a Sales-Assist Representative, you will have 3 main responsibilities:

•
Showcase Zapier as a potential solution for teams and businesses through multiple mediums - On a daily basis, most of your time will be on live chat (4+ hours) with customers through Zendesk. With the rest split between calls and emails. You’ll lead demos virtually to model a wide range of use-cases in which Zapier can help drive ROI for our customers. You’ll educate the user on use-cases to help inspire more ways they can automate within their business. You’ll lead them from interest, to learning more about our product to purchase. Success here is measured by our ability to qualify leads for other teams and convert customers yourself.

•
Create a Sales Pipeline for multiple motions- through live chat queues and product qualified lead (PQL) emails, you’ll drive an influenced revenue metric with qualified leads to be handed to other teams and members.

•
Maintain feedback loops back into the rest of the organization - Identifying learnings from your customer demos and passing them along as a feedback loop is critical in this role. This looks like tagging your call recordings with product feedback opportunities, or identifying areas where improved collateral may have accelerated the sales-process. To do so, you’ll need to be excellent at written communication.

You’ll work closely with numerous senior stakeholders and will be a part of several cross-functional steering committees as well.

How to Apply

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

title: Social Media Marketing Intern
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a creative, curious, and highly engaged social media enthusiast who genuinely enjoys spending time on platforms like X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Reddit. If you stay on top of trends, enjoy experimenting with content, and like building online communities, this role could be a great fit.

What You’ll Do

• Create short, engaging content across X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Reddit.

• Spot emerging trends and adapt them for Snezzi (https://himalayas.app/companies/snezzi) in a natural, platform-native way.

• Help grow our social accounts through consistent posting and thoughtful community engagement.

• Participate in relevant Reddit communities and online discussions to build brand presence authentically.

• Collaborate with the founders to create memes, short videos, carousels, and micro-content.

• Support creator collaborations, experiments, and small campaigns.

You’re a Great Fit If You

• Are highly active on social media and understand how different platforms work.

• Have grown your own or a brand’s Instagram or X account in the past.

• Participate in Reddit communities and know how to contribute value without spamming.

• Understand how brands can join conversations in a contextual and engaging way.

• Enjoy experimenting, learning quickly, and iterating based on feedback.

• Have strong communication skills and a good sense of humor.

Bonus Points

• You have experience editing videos or reels.

• You can design basic graphics or carousels.

• You’ve worked with a startup, creator, or online brand before.

What You’ll Get

• Hands-on experience building social presence for a fast-growing AI startup.

• Direct collaboration with the founding team and real ownership over content initiatives.

• Opportunities to experiment, learn, and build a strong portfolio.

• Remote work with flexible hours.
